questions.explanation: 'Should have + past participle' criticizes a past omission.
questions.q: You ___ told me you were ill — I would have helped.

questions.explanation: 'Should have studied' expresses regret about a past choice.
questions.q: She ___ studied medicine; she'd make a great doctor.

questions.explanation: After 'shouldn't have', use the past participle 'driven'.
options: You shouldn't have drove so fast.
You shouldn't had driven so fast.
You shouldn't have driven so fast.
You shouldn't to have driven so fast.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: 'Ought to have + past participle' expresses regret like 'should have'.
questions.q: We ___ to have left earlier.

questions.explanation: 'Needn't have worried' means the worry was unnecessary (but happened).
questions.q: You ___ worried — the results were excellent.

questions.explanation: 'Could have won' expresses a missed past possibility.
questions.q: They ___ have won if they'd tried harder.

questions.explanation: 'Shouldn't have + past participle' expresses regret about a past action.
questions.q: I ___ have stayed up so late — I'm exhausted.

questions.explanation: 'Could have called' reproaches someone for not acting.
questions.q: You ___ have called; I was awake all night.

questions.explanation: 'Was supposed to' expresses an unfulfilled past obligation.
questions.q: She was ___ to submit the report by Friday.

questions.explanation: 'Needn't have hurried' means they hurried unnecessarily.
questions.q: We ___ have hurried; the train was delayed.

questions.explanation: 'Should have' is followed by the past participle 'apologized'.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: 'Ought to have been' criticizes past carelessness.
questions.q: You ___ have been more careful with the documents.

questions.explanation: 'Should have told' expresses regret about a past decision.
questions.q: I ___ have told her the truth from the start.

questions.explanation: 'Must have known' expresses a confident deduction about the past.
questions.q: They ___ have known the risks involved.

questions.explanation: 'Ought' needs 'to': 'He ought to have called earlier'.
options: You should have seen his face!
She couldn't have done it alone.
questions.q: Find the sentence with a mistake.

questions.explanation: 'Might have guessed' expresses a missed past possibility.
questions.q: I ___ have guessed he'd forget.

questions.explanation: 'Shouldn't have eaten' expresses regret about overeating.
questions.q: You ___ have eaten so much cake.

questions.explanation: 'Could have been avoided' describes a missed past possibility in the passive.
questions.q: The accident ___ have been avoided with better brakes.

questions.explanation: 'Needn't have' takes the past participle 'waited'.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: 'Shouldn't have left' criticizes his past behavior.
questions.q: He ___ have left without saying goodbye.
